Recommend `selected: Id | null` (still a required prop) on `CategoryWheel`; page state becomes `$state<RankingCategory | null>(null)`. Preserve muted utility icons.

The gallery can keep its current explicit selection; update its documented contract to nullable selection, permanent tint, and rim indication. Verify initial absence of rankings/empty message, activation for all categories, constant fills across selection, no tick, and separate keyboard focus.

content.text:
Saved sketch to `/tmp/wheel-state-sol.md`.

Use required `selected: Id | null` and initialize page state to `null`. A tagged state adds no useful invariant here. Guard the entire board until selection, preserve the initial donations subtitle, and keep server data unchanged.

Apply sector tint permanently; selection changes only the accent rim. Remove the tick and preserve the separate neutral keyboard focus outline.
